description: This file defines the implementation of the DatabaseConnection class, which manages database connectivity, execution of SQL queries, and handling result sets within the WPEFramework's Plugin namespace.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages database connection lifecycle, executes SQL queries, and processes results with thread safety.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement that does not return results.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement and retrieves the number of rows modified.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query and returns the result set.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Callback for executing queries that do not return data, e.g., DDL statements.

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Callback for processing query result rows and populating a DatabaseTable.
